command:
(let* ((input "(list
 (let ((map (make-keymap)))
   (aset (car (cdr map)) 65 'raw-key-command)
   (let ((before (list (lookup-key map [65])
                       (where-is-internal 'raw-key-command (list map)))))
     (define-key map [66] 'api-key-command)
     (aset (car (cdr map)) 66 'raw-key-command)
     (list before (where-is-internal 'raw-key-command (list map)))))
 (let ((map (make-keymap)) (prefix (make-sparse-keymap)))
   (define-key prefix [120] 'prefix-command)
   (aset (car (cdr map)) 67 prefix)
   (list (mapcar #'car (accessible-keymaps map))
         (where-is-internal 'prefix-command (list map))))
 (let ((map (make-keymap)) (parent (make-sparse-keymap)))
   (define-key parent [65] 'parent)
   (set-keymap-parent map parent)
   (define-key map [65] nil)
   (let ((before (list (lookup-key map [65]) (aref (car (cdr map)) 65))))
     (define-key map [65] nil t)
     (append before (list (lookup-key map [65]) (aref (car (cdr map)) 65)))))
 (let ((map (make-keymap))
       (first (list 'payload)) (second (list 'payload)) (keys nil))
   (define-key map [65] first)
   (define-key map [66] second)
   (map-keymap #'(lambda (key value)
                  (setq keys (cons (list key (eq value first) (eq value second)) keys)))
               map)
   (nreverse keys)))
") (read (read-from-string input))) (prin1 (list (equal (string-trim (substring input (cdr read))) "") (eval (car read) t))))
